{"text":"ItemID: NA; Title: Fallen; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its melodic heavy rock fits, but I would choose something heavier this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: St. Anger       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its raw, abrasive sound is less appealing right now than melodic or progressive metal.
ItemID: NA; Title: Lateralus; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: After 10.000 Days, I would explore more Tool for the intricate rhythms and atmospheric songs.
ItemID: NA; Title: Three Days Grace; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It fits the direct, melodic rock side of my history, but it is not my first pick today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Ashes Of The Wake       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: My recent In Flames and heavier metal listening makes its aggressive riffs an appealing next choice.
ItemID: NA; Title: Mezmerize       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its rhythmic twists and strong hooks appeal to both my heavy and melodic tastes.
ItemID: NA; Title: Theory of a Deadman; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The accessible hard rock fits, but I am more interested in the metal options today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Lost and Found       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its heavy grooves seem compatible with my Disturbed listening, though other picks interest me more.
ItemID: NA; Title: Indestructible; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Ten Thousand Fists makes another Disturbed album appealing, but I would save it for another visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Death Magnetic; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The riff-driven metal fits my taste, but Lateralus and Ashes Of The Wake take priority this time."}
